taproot_access.title: Access
taproot_access.description: Every device on your tailnet, with what it may do. New devices start with nothing.
taproot_access.proxy_hint: sends model requests through taproot, for Claude Code and Codex.

taproot_access.load_failed: Could not load the device list: {{message}}

taproot_access.tagged_hint: Devices owned by tags rather than a person, such as servers.

taproot_access.addresses_hint: Callers on these addresses have no Tailscale identity, so they can never be admins.
taproot_access.unsaved_one: 1 unsaved change. Applies right away when saved.
taproot_access.unsaved_other: {{count}} unsaved changes. Applies right away when saved.
